contract.task_clause:
A 2.0 L flask holds 0.40 g of helium gas. If the helium is evacuated into a larger container while the temperature is held constant, what will the effect on the entropy of the helium be?
Option A: It will remain constant as the number of helium molecules does not change.
Option B: It will decrease as the gas will be more ordered in the larger flask.
Option C: It will decrease because the molecules will collide with the sides of the larger flask less often than they did in the smaller flask.
Option D: It will increase as the gas molecules will be more dispersed in the larger flask.
